title: Unable to Install or Upgrade AAPSClient on Android 14 (Samsung Galaxy S23 Ultra)
symptom: Unable to install or upgrade AAPSClient on Samsung Galaxy S23 Ultra (Android 14). Upgrading gives 'App not installed as package conflicts with an existing package.' Fresh install gives Google Play Protect warning and then same package conflict error.
cause: Android limitation: apps that use the same permission must be signed with the same key. A new permission in AAPSClient 3.3 to allow sending data to watch from multiple sources causes conflict with AAPS installed on same phone, which is signed with a different keystore.
fix: Compile AAPSClient yourself with the same keystore as AAPS, or do not have both AAPS and AAPSClient installed on the same phone.
evidence_quote: it's android limitation. Apps that use the same permission must be signed with the same key. Permission is new in 3.3 to allow sending data to watch from multiple sources
